name: Pole Star Court (Bắc Thần Tinh Đình)

bonuses.rule: while your array field is up and you are Composed, every 4 s the foe gains one Earth stack and its soonest art waits 0.3 s. A foe whose first art the Mirror warded fully takes double damage from your next array art.

story: The lake mirror of 160 and the flag the head made for himself in 560, the year he took the abbey's centre. Whole in his hands for six centuries; the Mountain-Pressing Seal presses what the field has gathered.

name: Rings of the Armillary (Tuyền Cơ Tam Hoàn)

bonuses.effect: Ring Within the Ring (Hoàn Trung Hoàn)
bonuses.rule: a Ring of the Hour you lay while your ring (a Field) is up becomes a second ring; while you hold both, the foe is Bound (it cannot flee) and takes your array damage once for each ring every second.

story: The armillary's spare circle, the ecliptic flag cut from the same bronze in 180, and the keeper's robe. They go to whoever keeps Tuyền Cơ Nghi, not to the prioress as such.
